timing_interpretation: Nested inclusive timings overlap and must not be summed. Native profiling identifies redundant work; it does not prove browser acceptance.
implementation_contract: Only complete results of three pure validators are reusable. No validator body or refusal is removed.
A guard immutably borrows the exact collections and manifest for one Store::load operation. Results are keyed by validator and exact input identity.
No RefCell borrow is held while another validator runs.
Guard identities prevent nested or out-of-order drops from restoring a cache after input borrows end.
All results expire at scope exit, including errors; no cross-load, cross-bundle or workspace cache is introduced.
